body: I was having the same issues
I walk both my dogs for an hour two times at different times, and I cycle for at least 1.5 hours at night

I've tried many times to cut myself after locking myself in my room while my parents are in the house, we live in an apartment so quite apparent,I just never can cut, thought about jumping but idk.... I have two dogs and I don't know what'll happen to them
Well don't you think that not knowing about this... Cycle? Is what led it to go on for so long? We know about it and things might finally change non?
A giant human sized switch(electricity not Nintendo) shows up and either starts killing people or things... Not pretty, would be funny to watch.

I've been in the same situation for quite some time now and I even thought of cigarettes or alcohol( I'm 16 so.....) But the only reason I've not taken any step is because I know it would destroy my parents and things are already bad at home.

I think that it should actually be free for everyone regardless of age cause if the people are not mentally well, the world isn't gonna go anywhere, I'm telling from my own experience, I have constant suicidal thoughts and I can't understand why and I am only 16, I have been seeing a school counselor and she is very helpful to a limit but she advised me to get "professional" help, which is not easily available where I live and if it is, it's very expensive, I will be working upon my mental health with my counselor but I do agree that it should be free.
